summary: Enova International filed an 8-K disclosing that on October 16, 2026 it and Grasshopper Bancorp mutually terminated their December 10, 2025 Agreement and Plan of Merger, as amended December 18, 2025, under which Grasshopper would have merged into Enova followed by a merger of an interim national bank subsidiary into Grasshopper Bank N.A. Under the Mutual Termination Agreement and Release, Enova paid Grasshopper $4.0 million cash, with no other fees or liabilities owed by either party. The original terms were set out in the Form S-4 proxy/prospectus (File No. 333-292287). Watch for any refiled bank-acquisition strategy and the modest $4 million termination cost.
